jurisdictions.mainLaw: Privacy Act 1988
jurisdictions.verificationStatus: Verified from reviewed official source
jurisdictions.notes: Oceania regional workbook update.

practicalHighlights.label: Data Subject Rights
practicalHighlights.value: Access and correction rights under APP 12 and APP 13; complaints/review mechanisms through OAIC.

practicalHighlights.label: DSR Response Deadline
practicalHighlights.value: Access: organisation must respond within a reasonable period; OAIC guidance treats 30 calendar days as reasonable. Australian Government agencies must respond within 30 days. Correction: reasonable period under APP 13.

practicalHighlights.label: Breach Notification Deadline
practicalHighlights.value: No fixed 72-hour notification deadline. For eligible data breach, notify OAIC and affected individuals as soon as practicable after reasonable grounds exist. If only suspected, assessment must be carried out expeditiously and all reasonable steps must be taken to complete it within 30 days.

practicalHighlights.label: Cross-Border Transfer
practicalHighlights.value: Restricted with safeguards. APP 8 generally requires reasonable steps to ensure overseas recipient does not breach APPs, unless an exception applies.

practicalHighlights.label: DPO Requirement
practicalHighlights.value: No general private-sector DPO requirement. Australian Government agencies subject to the Privacy Code must have a designated Privacy Officer and Privacy Champion.

jurisdictions.practicalAction: Set access/correction SLA to 30 calendar days; design breach assessment workflow with 30-day assessment cap and notification as soon as practicable once eligible breach is confirmed; review APP 8 transfer controls.

practicalHighlights.label: Data Subject Rights
practicalHighlights.value: Access and correction rights under IPP 6 and IPP 7; complaint rights through OPC.

practicalHighlights.label: DSR Response Deadline
practicalHighlights.value: Access request: as soon as reasonably practicable and no later than 20 working days after receipt, subject to extension rules.

practicalHighlights.label: Breach Notification Deadline
practicalHighlights.value: Notify the Privacy Commissioner and affected individuals as soon as practicable after becoming aware of a notifiable privacy breach. OPC expects notification within 72 hours as a guide, but the statute uses 'as soon as practicable'.

practicalHighlights.label: Cross-Border Transfer
practicalHighlights.value: Restricted with safeguards. IPP 12 limits disclosure of personal information to a foreign person or entity unless conditions are met, including comparable safeguards or other permitted bases.

practicalHighlights.label: DPO Requirement
practicalHighlights.value: Mandatory privacy officer. Every agency must have at least one privacy officer.

jurisdictions.practicalAction: Set DSR SLA to 20 working days; implement breach escalation with target notification within 72 hours where notifiable; assign privacy officer and document IPP 12 transfer checks.
